accepted.measurement_type_evidence: record description: 'Masks were manually corrected by the authors ... most substantial changes in the acetabulum'

P2.measured_quantity: acetabular bone surface (mask -> surface) per hip
P2.chain: NIfTI mask (1.5 mm isotropic, xyzt_units space=2 => mm, sform_code=1) -> isosurface -> acetabular pelvic passage/cup -> mean radii; gives the bone socket, i.e. the outer edge of the cartilage layer
P2.direction: the bone socket’s innermost bone surface corresponds to the acfyte + layer P9, not P2 directly
P2.limit: BONE surface, not cartilage surface. P2 cannot be set to this number; it gives a measurement interval for the surface that P2 + P9 jointly delimit.

accepted.name: Wear of femoral head taper connections of contemporary total hip prostheses—An experimental study
accepted.size_evidence: api sizes: 'Data files Figures 10 and 11.zip'=18806, 'data dictionary for SEM and EDX.xlsx'=11257
accepted.format: 2 XLSX (Figure 10 = demonteringskraft per grupp, Figure 11 = 22kolumners matris) + 1 XLSX dataordbok
accepted.n_subjects_evidence: data dictionary + paper: 24 stems, 8 groups of n=3 (2 taper x 2 headmaterial x 2 testtype); Fig 10 has 24 force rows
accepted.measurement_type: explanted commercial hip implants, measured in vitro (load frame LF + hip simulator HJS)
accepted.measurement_type_evidence: data dictionary: 'hut4 = hip joint simulator test', 'jj = "12/14" taper, Summit, DePuy', 'zb = "Type 1" taper, Taperloc Complete, Zimmer Biomet'
accepted.frame: not applicable — table data without spatial reference

P10.measured_quantity: disassembly force for femoral head against stem, 1.76-3.44 kN, 24 measurements
P10.chain: XLSX 'Force (kN)' -> kN->N -> order of magnitude for the force holding a loaded hip joint construction together
P10.direction: quantitative order of magnitude (1.76-3.44 kN is above HX 1.8 kN)
P10.limit: DECISIVE LIMITATION: this is the TAPER/TRUNNION joint (neck-head), NOT the articulation surface (head-socket). The number is a disassembly force, not an in-vivo joint load. It may be used as an order of magnitude for P10, never as the value of P10.

does_not_constrain.P4: TAPER GEOMETRY (d1, d2, contact length, cone angle) is in the paper’s table, NOT in the downloaded data files. Thus no diametral clearance is measured in this sample -> P4 (clearance_m) remains UNCONSTRAINED by S3.
does_not_constrain.P5/P6: No as-built-against-CAD surface and no error profile in the files.
